question.problem:
$$
\overset{A}{\overset{⏞}{[\begin{aligned}| & | & | \\ {a}_{1} & {a}_{2} & {a}_{3} \\ | & | & |\end{aligned}]}}=\overset{Q}{\overset{⏞}{[\begin{aligned}| & | & | \\ {q}_{1} & {q}_{2} & {q}_{3} \\ | & | & |\end{aligned}]}}\overset{R}{\overset{⏞}{[\begin{aligned}{r}_{11} & {r}_{12} & {r}_{13} \\ 0 & {r}_{22} & {r}_{23} \\ 0 & 0 & {r}_{33}\end{aligned}]}}
$$

Consider the QR factorization of the matrix $A$ shown above. You're given that the system of equations given below connects the columns of $Q$ and the columns of $A.$  

$$
\{\begin{aligned}{q}_{1}=\frac{1}{4}{a}_{1} \\ {q}_{2}=\frac{1}{2}{a}_{2}+{q}_{1} \\ {q}_{3}=\frac{1}{3}{a}_{3}+2{q}_{1}-{q}_{2}\end{aligned}
$$

What is the value of ${r}_{13}+{r}_{22}+{r}_{23}?$
question.worked_solution:
Let's rewrite the vectors ${a}_{1},{a}_{2},{a}_{3}$ as a linear combination of the vectors ${q}_{1},{q}_{2},{q}_{3}:$

$$
\{\begin{aligned}{q}_{1}=\frac{1}{4}{a}_{1} \\ {q}_{2}=\frac{1}{2}{a}_{2}+{q}_{1} \\ {q}_{3}=\frac{1}{3}{a}_{3}+2{q}_{1}-{q}_{2}\end{aligned}\,⟹\,\{\begin{aligned}{a}_{1}=4{q}_{1} \\ {a}_{2}=-2{q}_{1}+2{q}_{2} \\ {a}_{3}=-6{q}_{1}+3{q}_{2}+3{q}_{3}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, this system can be written in matrix form as follows:

$$
\overset{A}{\overset{⏞}{[\begin{aligned}| & | & | \\ {a}_{1} & {a}_{2} & {a}_{3} \\ | & | & |\end{aligned}]}}=\overset{Q}{\overset{⏞}{[\begin{aligned}| & | & | \\ {q}_{1} & {q}_{2} & {q}_{3} \\ | & | & |\end{aligned}]}}\overset{R}{\overset{⏞}{[\begin{aligned}4 & -2 & -6 \\ 0 & 2 & 3 \\ 0 & 0 & 3\end{aligned}]}}
$$

Therefore, 

$$
{r}_{13}+{r}_{22}+{r}_{23}=-6+2+3=-1.
$$
